# Vendored Sandbox SDK

Built `dist` output of `@sandbox-sdk/core` and `@sandbox-sdk/cloudflare` from
[githubnext/sandbox](https://github.com/githubnext/sandbox), a fork of
[dancer/sandbox](https://github.com/dancer/sandbox), at
2a7f1ff68bec23ed28beab55dbdefe68c31c7203 on its `ace` branch (MIT, see LICENSE). Change the SDK
in the fork, then rebuild and copy both `dist` directories here. The packages are not published
to npm yet; replace this directory with registry versions once they are.
